definition: [ כִּרְסֵם ] verb quadriliteral = Pi`el , tear off (compare קִרְסֵם Late Hebrew cut or eat away , Deut 28:38 ᵑ7 J for חָסַל ; on form see Ges «GKC:56»§ 56 ); — only Imperfect 3 masculine singular suffix: — יְכַרְסְמֶנָּה חֲזִיר מִיָּ֫עַר Ps 80:14 teareth it off (that is, the vine, figurative of Israel).
